Macabee Pizza Bagels (Frozen)

Ingredients:
1 frozen Macabee pizza bagel (2 halves)

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven (or toaster oven) to 425°F.
2. Place the frozen pizza bagel halves on a baking sheet, cheese side up.
3. Bake 10-12 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the bagel edges are crisp.
4. Rest 1-2 minutes before eating.
note: Store-bought frozen staple, 1 serving = 1 pizza bagel (2 halves). Directions are standard bake-from-frozen; Yidi will send package photos when home — put 'Confirm exact directions from package' in the recipe notes. Kosher: dairy. Category: Main. Tags: frozen, store-bought, lunch, staple.
